cohort: This study involved 50 term/late preterm neonates admitted to the NICU due to EOS, alongside 50 healthy neonates matched for gestational age range and sex.
finding: Early-onset neonatal sepsis is associated with vitamin D deficiency in neonates and their mothers, low birth weight, and being delivered by C-section.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was more prevalent among the sepsis cases (P < 0.001).
followup_time: Within the first week of life
